title: Frozen Margarita Made With Limeade
description:
A great, easy recipe for large batches of delicious frozen margaritas! No blenders or ice required for this recipe!
Mix all of the following ingredients in a plastic bag or tupperware, then place in freezer. Serve with a ladle once it
sets to a slushie consistency!
ingredients: If you wanted them really smooth and “creamy” you could give them a quick final whiz in the food processor or
directions: Or, for the hard way, you can skip the water above and make them with a blender by crushing the ice.
These can be served with limes and rim-salted glasses.
With an 8 oz limeade can and water, this is 88 oz, or enough for 11 8 oz drinks; with a 12 oz limeade can, 16.5
In a blender, add the can of limeade. Using the empty can measure the tequila and the triple sec and add to the
blender. Blend, adding ice (50/50 liquid/ice) until the drink becomes slushy and holds in peaks.
